title: Sometimes
text:
Sometimes when it was

still too early to see you

or when the window

opened onto the distance and the sound

of so much laid iron and so much sand

that crunches like foreign land on the roads,

remote from hope,

I returned to that place where we left

our solitudes together and our voices.


I found you contained,

with scattered heart and joy

on every side, and floating

in the secure and abundant night

that is never consummated.


Yet in the distance,

as soon as you welcomed me with the names

of common things, in silence

I felt that your island was no longer within my reach.


Then, entirely

reincorporated into the body's limit,

I returned to the certainty of waiting.
editorial_note: The translation keeps Barral's movement from distant sensory memory back into the body's waiting boundary.

title: I Cannot Remember...
text:
I cannot remember

why I chose that kingdom of brick.

Why the corner so damp, the green

corner of the corridor?

Only terror passed by, sometimes

the insolent figure devoured

almost at once by the light.

I was always alone, at least

as far as I remember. When she came in

she seemed barefoot to me,

her bare skin tall in the shaken half-light.


The airs up to the ceiling

were dyed with her, and everything smelled

of nocturnal animal;

I myself was her smell, I myself

almost like her foam.


She did not pass by again.

Her body remained in me, the certainty

beneath all clothing.


She broke the hours of doing nothing,

sowed the instrumental and white world

with fear, among fears.
editorial_note: The translation preserves Barral's memory of a single apparition altering a sterile, fearful interior.

title: Ascent of Love
text:
Look at the

airs, solitary soul,

sad soul that goes alone moaning.


Ascend, rise. Love awaits you.


God awaits you at the summit of your flight.

Fluttering,

trembling and white,

I see you rise whole among the winds.

You

are growing golden. Solar you are.


Clear and solar above the skies.

Lonely soul

of God beside his face,

face of light that covers the firmament.


Immense you are, touched by newborn light.


Immense you are, drinking God's light.

Face to

face beside God, you contemplate.

Face to face I see you.

Life with

life, light with light,


heaven with heaven.

Light of

love, light of life


slowly descending in the airs I feel.

Fused light of God with light of the

soul.


Oh clarity in the silence!
editorial_note: The translation supplies the missing 'Love' from the title and parallel source variant, preserving the mystical ascent toward divine light.
